bio: Daniel Kálmán Biss (born August 27, 1977) is an American mathematician and politician who is Congressman-elect for Illinois's 9th congressional district. He served as the mayor of Evanston, Illinois, from 2021 to 2026. He is a former member of both the Illinois House of Representatives and Illinois Senate.
